concept: A massive crowd of silhouetted figures with raised fists and protest signs, compressed into a narrow urban street canyon with tall buildings looming overhead. Tear gas clouds billow in thick, geometric shapes. One figure lies on the ground. Stark, high-contrast composition with deep shadows and sudden bursts of orange and red light from fires or flares. Graphic, almost woodcut-like style with bold outlines and minimal detail. Overhead view fading into ground-level chaos.
explanation: Today's headlines are dominated by conflict, displacement, and loss across multiple continents—mass arrests in France, demolished homes in Palestine, a school shooting aftermath, a tragic drowning, and structural collapse in Nairobi. While some positive notes emerge (Starlink restored, tariffs adjusted, cancer remission), they're vastly outnumbered by human suffering and systemic violence. The street protests and tear gas in Paris became the visual anchor, but the image attempts to compress the broader sense of a world convulsing with confrontation, displacement, and powerlessness.

headlines.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
headlines.summary: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.

headlines.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
headlines.summary: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

headlines.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes
headlines.summary: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.

headlines.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
headlines.summary: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

headlines.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
headlines.summary: Nathan Gregory says the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne "is unimaginable for our family".

headlines.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
headlines.summary: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.

headlines.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
headlines.summary: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.

headlines.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
headlines.summary: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

headlines.title: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse with five still missing
headlines.summary: Police have launched a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor after the multi-storey building collapsed while still under construction.

headlines.title: Minneapolis withdrawal was 'surrender', Trump's ex-border patrol chief tells BBC
headlines.summary: Greg Bovino was the public face of the controversial immigration enforcement operation in the city earlier this year.

headlines.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
headlines.summary: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

headlines.title: Fireworks and tear gas as protesters and riot police clash in Paris
headlines.summary: The BBC's Europe correspondent reports from Paris where mostly peaceful protests turned into unrest after nightfall.
